summaryZh: Bintu 实验室开发和应用空间转录组及基因组成像工具，研究基因调控信息如何从细胞核分子事件跨尺度联系到组织结构与动物行为。具体项目涉及神经再生、阿片成瘾与戒断中的丘脑作用，以及亨廷顿病 CAG 扩增；技术开发包括 MERFISH、大尺度厚组织成像和与 CRISPR 筛选及连接组学的结合。
researchQuestions: 基因调控信息如何跨越分子、细胞、组织和行为尺度？

evidence.quote: We develop and apply new imaging tools (including spatial transcriptomics and genomics) to understand how gene regulation information propagates across scales from the molecular events within the nucleus to the organization of cells into tissues and organs, up to the scale of animal behavior.

Current projects in the lab include identification of the molecular basis of Neuroregeneration, determining the transcriptomics/connectivity role of the Thalamus within the Opioid addiction/withdrawal circuitry, developing a quantitative spatial readout for Huntingtons CAG expansions.
Bintu Lab Principal Investigator: Bogdan Bintu
